stories.title: Serial sexual predator found guilty on 39 counts
stories.summary: Munguia was arrested in April 2023 in connection with two "extremely violent sexual assault" crimes.

stories.title: 5 injured, including children, in multi-vehicle crash in west Phoenix
stories.summary: Five people were transported to the hospital, including three children, the Phoenix Fire Department said.

stories.title: MCAO's new attorney gets drunk at after-hours training, is disciplined
stories.summary: The attorney was disciplined after he didn't conduct himself in a professional way, said MCAO. The training asked the attorney to drink alcohol.

stories.title: Drone delivery giant Zipline plans Phoenix expansion, with potential for 65,000 deliveries per day
stories.summary: The California-based company hopes to launch in the Valley in early 2027, offering deliveries of food, groceries and medications from the air.

stories.title: Cooler temperatures and sunny skies stay in the forecast for the Valley
stories.summary: An extended, very preliminary look ahead to Thanksgiving Day shows sunny skies in the Valley with temperatures in the 70s.

stories.title: 'He's fighting for his life': Driver on the I-10 in Buckeye struck by large wood debris
stories.summary: The victim was simply driving along I-10 in Buckeye when a giant piece of wood flew through his windshield. Those few seconds have now changed his life forever.

stories.title: Arizona's universities delaying recruiting for fraternities, sororities
stories.summary: Greek life recruitment for first-year students will now be done during spring semester at Arizona's public universities.

stories.title: Here's your chance to win a JW Desert Ridge stay and tickets to ICE!
stories.summary: Win a JW Desert Ridge stay and tickets to ICE! Elf.

stories.title: Wanted fugitive arrested in Flagstaff 25 years after alleged crime
stories.summary: Thomas Crumpler had a warrant out of Lubbock County, Texas for indecency with a child.

stories.title: Arizona's incoming schools chief Terry Leyba Ruiz outlines plans for rural schools, ESA reforms
stories.summary: The state's first Latina superintendent says she wants to strengthen oversight of the voucher program without taking funding away from families who use it properly.

stories.title: Arizona town approves business license for immigration detention facility
stories.summary: The Arizona town of Marana has approved a business license for Management & Training Corporation to run an immigration detention center in a former state prison.

stories.title: Pedestrian dead after hit by car in south Phoenix, police say
stories.summary: A man was killed after being struck by a vehicle near 19th Avenue and Baseline Road on Tuesday.
